name: Old City of Zamość
description: Zamość, in southeastern Poland, was founded in the 1580s by chancellor Jan Zamoyski and designed by Padua-born architect Bernardo Morando as an "ideal city" of the Italian Renaissance. Its original street plan and fortifications survive, and its arcaded townhouses, which blend Italian and Central European styles, surround a spacious central market square. The town was built to profit from a trade route running to the Black Sea.
